svg.title: Stationary fuel-cell system — Fuel and oxidant
svg.desc: Fuel and oxidant. 5 equipment references and 4 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
svg.text: Fuel and oxidant · declared connections · illustrative equipment symbols
